entry: Invoke $factory-build with your outcome, or choose $factory-blueprint, $factory-resume or $factory-status in the main session. The underlying $factory-start workflow remains available.

sources.requirement: Root and nested instruction files contribute guidance, subject to overrides and the configured byte limit.
Project agent TOML files require name, description and developer_instructions. Parent live permission overrides can supersede child defaults.
Project configuration is loaded only for trusted projects; CLI and native IDE extension share configuration layers.

Repository skills are discovered under .agents/skills; duplicate names are not merged. Entry skills use name/description and agents/openai.yaml default_prompt metadata; normal implicit discovery remains enabled.
The integrated VS Code Codex harness uses a different custom-agent discovery path and does not enforce the Markdown tools field as an allowlist.
Discover models for the actual account/client/harness. Validate constraints and record requested versus observed selection separately.

limits: No model or reasoning-effort override is generated.
Read-only reviewer and planner defaults must be confirmed against effective parent permissions.
Orchestrator enforcement is instructions only: the factory does not review or generate Codex hooks.
No hooks, credentials, provider changes, sandbox bypass or automatic approvals are installed.
Installed version output alone does not prove agent discovery or runtime compatibility.

Generated .codex/config.toml adds only [agents] max_concurrent_threads_per_session = 3, and nothing when the user already sets it or the legacy max_threads; it never writes agents.enabled. Older Codex releases (0.114 observed) reject unknown [agents] keys and fail to start, so on such a client remove the [agents] table or upgrade Codex; no minimum version is verified.
An existing features.multi_agent = false disables subagents and is reported as a render error with guidance; it is never rewritten.

Codex sandboxes cannot write the uv cache, so AGENTS.md names the pinned .factory/.venv/bin/software-factory entrypoint for sandboxed sessions; render warns when the whole AGENTS.md exceeds 32 KiB (project_doc_max_bytes default).

When the copilot profile is also active, .agents/skills entry skills carry argument-hint and user-invocable and other skills user-invocable: false for Copilot; Codex ignores frontmatter keys it does not know (documentation-based, not live-verified).
Future work: Codex hooks could back an orchestrator guard; they are not reviewed or generated yet.
factory-models provides constrained model planning; requested selection is not proof of the model actually used. No global model settings are rewritten.

model_selection.inventory: app-server model/list with partial capability metadata
model_selection.application: host session picker or supported native subagent control; dispatch report does not apply settings
model_selection.effective_identity: runtime evidence when exposed; otherwise unknown
